title: Man with weapon killed as Vancouver police open fire
subtitle: A man in his 40s died at the Patricia Hotel on Hastings Street after police fired gun shots.
article: A man who police said was carrying a weapon was shot and killed Thursday during a confrontation with Vancouver police in the Downtown Eastside.
The Independent Investigations Office is investigating.
The Vancouver police said officers responded to a complaint at the Patricia Hotel in the 400-block of East Hastings Street shortly after 4 p.m.
Police said in a statement that officers were confronted by a man. Shots were fired, and a man in his 40s died.
In a news release Friday, the IIO said the man was reported to have a weapon.
The IIO is asking anyone with relevant information to contact the witness line toll-free at 1-855-446-8477 or via the contact form on the iiobc.ca website.
